notes.title: Game Update Patch Notes-Ver1.01-October 29, 2019
notes.content:
Game Update Patch Notes-Ver1.01-October 29, 2019

1. Mouse Sensitivity Adjusted
Mouse sensitivity for when aiming has been adjusted. 
The main change is that aim speed will no longer accelerate as 
a result of the character rotating.

2. Fixed Issue with 3D Resolution
We have fixed the issue which caused the game screen to upscale 
and always display at 75% of the chosen resolution. 
Note that in some environments, this may cause a reduction in framerate.

3. Fixed E-Needle Issue
We have fixed the issue of the Prowl Rider’s E-Needle energy move 
sometimes not clinging to a wall surface when in contact with a collision (wall, etc).

4. Fixed Language Setting Issue
We have fixed the issue of the Tutorial displaying in Japanese regardless of the 
user’s current Steam language setting. After this fix, if you still experience issues 
with the wrong language displaying, please reselect your language setting 
at the game’s title screen.

5. Fixed Issue with Moving Using the Keyboard
We have fixed the issue occurring when using the keyboard to move (walk) or sprint, 
in which a character would stop moving when too many keys were pressed at once.
 Specifically, when pressing the key to walk backward (S) simultaneously with 
the key to walk forward (W), and then releasing the key to walk backward, 
the character would stop moving, despite the walk forward key still being 
pressed; this issue has been fixed.

We have fixed the issue of the Tutorial displaying in Japanese regardless of the user’s current Steam language setting.
We have fixed the issue occurring when using the keyboard to move (walk) or sprint, in which a character would stop moving when too many keys were pressed at once.
